queries: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_average_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, p.average_hgb - o.overall_average_hgb AS above_overall_average FROM patient_averages p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_average_hgb) SELECT ID, average_hgb, above_overall_average, average_hgb - (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) FROM kept) AS difference_from_kept_average FROM kept ORDER BY difference_from_kept_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, o.overall_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_hgb) SELECT ID, average_hgb, average_hgb - overall_hgb AS above_overall_average, average_hgb - AVG(average_hgb) OVER () AS above_kept_patient_average FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_patient_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.avg_hgb AS above_overall FROM patient_averages p CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_hgb), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_kept_hgb FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.avg_hgb, k.above_overall, k.avg_hgb - ka.avg_kept_hgb AS above_kept_average FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average ka ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC LIMIT 10
